description.narrative: (Nigeria): -The Nigeria Expanded Trade and Transportation (NEXTT) activity is a response to trade and transportation-related barriers undermining Nigeria's food production and making the country largely dependent on food imports.-The NEXTT activity will support the Government of Nigeria (GON) to improve trade policy, build trade capacity, and remove bottlenecks impeding the free flow of goods, particularly agricultural goods along the Lagos-Kano-Jibiya (LAKAJI) Corridor. NEXTT in FY 2014 will streamline these interventions to better match the Feed the Future value chains and the GON Agricultural Transformation Agenda in specific Staple Crop Processing Zones located along the corridor. -The activity will facilitate new agricultural investments along the LAKAJI Corridor through a Project Development Facility and strengthen the relationship between private sector business and exporting enterprises.
